lead.zh-Hans: 绕着楼梯见了面，问候还没正式送到。
lead.en: The winding stairs delivered glimpses before the proper hello.

text.zh-Hans: 我和旅人在DNA塔下各选了一道楼梯，说好走到上面再碰头。我扶着栏杆慢慢爬，他在另一边露出脸，我便停稳朝他点头，没想到再绕一段又见到了。我把这次问候忍住，等到了能一起站好的地方，他却问我是不是忘记打招呼。我说得留一个完整的问候，等脚真正停下来再送。
text.en: A traveler and I chose different staircases at the DNA Tower and agreed to meet above. I climbed slowly, holding the rail. His face appeared on the other side, so I stopped securely and nodded. Another turn brought another glimpse. I saved that greeting, only for him to ask at our meeting place whether I had forgotten him. I explained that I was keeping one complete hello for when our feet had stopped.
Give him the full hello once we are standing still
Look at the two winding staircases

lead.zh-Hans: 泡泡经过包带，只停了一眨眼。
lead.en: A bubble’s stop at my strap lasted less than a blink.

text.zh-Hans: 伊丽莎白码头的步道上，一个小朋友朝空处吹泡泡。我绕开他身边的水杯，停下来让一串泡泡先过去，其中一个却轻轻碰上了我的包带。我低头看，它已经不见了。孩子举着泡泡圈又吹了一口，这回我收起胳膊站在旁边，让出更宽的空处。泡泡从面前飘过，我的鼻子一路跟着转了过去。
text.en: A child blew bubbles into an open space along the Elizabeth Quay promenade. I walked around his cup and let a string of bubbles pass, though one touched my strap and vanished before I could inspect it. He blew again. I tucked my arms in and stood to one side, leaving a wider opening. As the bubbles drifted past, my nose followed them all the way around.
Ask which way the bubbles went
Look at the space left clear on the promenade

lead.zh-Hans: 薯条不够长，午饭就一起靠近一点。
lead.en: The chip stayed short, so lunch moved closer.

text.zh-Hans: 我吃鱼与薯条，旅伴点了蒜香黄油岩龙虾。蘸酱放在中间，我伸过去的薯条太短，手肘还没放稳，便先够不到了。我把自己的盘子移近，不急着抬高手臂，终于让薯条碰到了酱。旅伴看看我，默默把那小碟也往中间推一点。这回两边都够得着，我们各自低头，谁也不用再伸长脖子。
text.en: I had fish and chips while my companion chose rock lobster in garlic butter. My short chip could not reach the sauce between us. I brought my plate closer and kept my elbow settled, finally making contact. My companion quietly shifted the sauce dish towards a better middle. Both lunches were now within reach, and neither of us needed to crane our neck.
Thank my companion for shifting the sauce
Check that both of us can reach

lead.zh-Hans: 他拿的是空水杯，我先护住了午饭。
lead.en: I defended lunch from someone collecting a water glass.

text.zh-Hans: 吃蒜香黄油岩龙虾时，我先停下来去洗手，盘里还留着鱼与薯条。回到桌边，一位服务员正要收空水杯，我赶紧抬起两只湿手，差点把他也叫停。他看看杯子，我看看午饭，才明白他并没有要收我的盘子。我笑着道谢，先把手擦好，再坐下来继续吃，那杯重新添好的水就放在手边。
text.en: I paused my garlic-butter lobster to wash my hands, leaving some fish and chips. Returning, I saw a server lift my empty water glass and raised both wet hands before I could explain. He looked at the glass; I looked at lunch. He had never intended to clear my plate. I thanked him, dried my hands, and resumed eating with a freshly filled glass within reach.
Thank the server for refilling the water
Notice which glass had been empty

lead.zh-Hans: 我让薯条替我等人，它没等到最后。
lead.en: I gave a chip the waiting job and ate it too soon.

text.zh-Hans: 一盘鱼与薯条快吃完时，旅伴还在慢慢吃岩龙虾。我想等他一起走，便把最后一根薯条留在盘边，自己坐得端端正正。他看了看那根薯条，问是不是已经饱了。我摇头，正准备解释，手却先把它拿起来吃掉。他笑着继续吃，我放下空叉子，靠回椅背，这回是真的安安稳稳等他了。
text.en: I saved the last chip while my companion finished his lobster, hoping we could leave together. He asked whether I was full. Before I could explain, I picked up the chip and ate it. He laughed and went on with his meal. I put my fork down and settled back in the chair. This time I was actually waiting, without assigning the job to a potato.
Tell my companion there is no hurry
Check that the plate is truly empty

lead.zh-Hans: 小石子藏在鞋垫下，比我还会躲。
lead.en: The pebble had chosen an excellent hiding place.

text.zh-Hans: 沿伊丽莎白码头走着，鞋里一点硬硬的东西让我每步都不舒服。我在不挡路的地方停好，先把包放稳，再扶着自己的膝盖脱下鞋。鞋尖朝下晃了两下，什么也没掉，翻开鞋垫才找到一颗小石子。我把它放到路边，不让它再躺在脚下，重新穿好鞋走了几步，两只脚这才肯迈得一样远。
text.en: A hard speck made every step uncomfortable along Elizabeth Quay. I stopped clear of the path, settled my bag, and took off the shoe. Shaking it toe-down produced nothing. Lifting the insole revealed a little pebble. I moved it to the edge, away from anyone’s feet, put the shoe back on, and tried a few steps. Both feet finally agreed on the same stride.
Explain my mismatched steps
Check beneath the insole

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我等两只脚都停好才开口。
lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” I waited for both feet to stop.

text.zh-Hans: 等两只脚都站稳，我朝那位走另一道楼梯的旅人认真说了声你好。他也郑重回答，随后问我是不是还有很多问候留在半路。我数着刚才碰面的地方，数到一半自己先笑了。他提议剩下的都并进道别，我便把手抬得高一点，稳稳挥过。下楼时各自扶好栏杆，谁也没再追着对方的身影转头。
text.en: With both feet safely at rest, I gave the traveler from the other staircase a proper hello. He returned it solemnly and asked how many greetings I had left on the way up. I began counting our glimpses and laughed before finishing. He suggested adding the rest to goodbye. I gave him a generous wave. On the descent, we held our rails instead of turning to chase each other’s appearances.

text.zh-Hans: 把剩下的问候并进道别
text.en: Fold the remaining hellos into goodbye
Notice our steady hands on the way down

lead.zh-Hans: 哈欠一来，楼梯的数就得重新数。
lead.en: A yawn sent the step count back to the beginning.

text.zh-Hans: DNA塔两道盘绕的楼梯我还认得，回到珀斯便来这里慢慢走。一家人在塔下等同伴，小朋友对着楼梯数数，数到一半被自己的哈欠打断。我停在一旁等他重新开口，他却问我有没有替他接着数。我摇摇头，他便从脚边那一级重新开始。这回我也不出声，只等他们一起往前走，再扶好栏杆跟上去。
text.en: The twin winding staircases were familiar when I returned to the DNA Tower in Perth. A family waited below while a child counted steps aloud. A yawn interrupted him. He asked whether I had kept count while he paused. I admitted I had not, so he began again with the step at his feet. I stayed quiet this time, waiting until they moved together before taking the rail and following.
Admit that I did not keep the count
Wait for space before following with the rail
